bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the reference executable

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The reference `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the reference `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

See [benchmarks](#benchmarks) below. - **Typed property values** – many other CSS parsers treat property values as an untyped series of tokens. This means that each transformer that wants to do something with these values must interpret them itself, leading to duplicate work and inconsistencies. Lightning CSS parses all values using the grammar from the CSS specification, and exposes a specific value type for each property. - **Browser-grade parser** – Lightning CSS is built on browser-grade CSS parsing foundations to provide a solid general purpose CSS-parsing foundation. - **Minification** – One of the main purposes of Lightning CSS is to minify CSS to make it smaller. This includes many optimizations including: - Combining longhand properties into shorthands where possible. - Merging adjacent rules with the same selectors or declarations when it is safe to do so. - Combining CSS transforms into a single matrix or vice versa when smaller. - Removing vendor prefixes that are not needed, based on the provided browser targets. - Reducing `calc()` expressions where possible. - Converting colors to shorter hex notation where possible. - Minifying gradients. - Minifying CSS grid templates. - Normalizing property value order. - Removing default property sub-values which will be inferred by browsers. - Many micro-optimizations, e.g. converting to shorter units, removing unnecessary quotation marks, etc. - **Vendor prefixing** – Lightning CSS accepts a list of browser targets, and automatically adds (and removes) vendor prefixes. - **Browserslist configuration** – Lightning CSS supports opt-in browserslist configuration discovery to resolve browser targets and integrate with your existing tools and config setup. - **Syntax lowering** – Lightning CSS parses modern CSS syntax, and generates more compatible output where needed, based on browser targets. - CSS Nesting - Custom media queries (draft spec) - Logical properties * [Color Level 5](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-5/) - `color-mix()` function - Relative color syntax, e.g. `lab(from purple calc(l * .8) a b)` - [Color Level 4](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/) - `lab()`, `lch()`, `oklab()`, and `oklch()` colors - `color()` function supporting predefined color spaces such as `display-p3` and `xyz` - Space separated components in `rgb` and `hsl` functions - Hex with alpha syntax - `hwb()` color syntax - Percent syntax for opacity - `#rgba` and `#rrggbbaa` hex colors - Selectors - `:not` with multiple arguments - `:lang` with multiple arguments - `:dir` - `:is` - Double position gradient stops (e.g. `red 40% 80%`) - `clamp()`, `round()`, `rem()`, and `mod()` math functions - Alignment shorthands (e.g. `place-items`) - Two-value `overflow` shorthand - Media query range syntax (e.g. `@media (width <= 100px)` or `@media (100px < width < 500px)`) - Multi-value `display` property (e.g. `inline flex`) - `system-ui` font family fallbacks - **CSS modules** – Lightning CSS supports compiling a subset of CSS modules features. - Locally scoped class and id selectors - Locally scoped custom identifiers, e.g. `@keyframes` names, grid lines/areas, `@counter-style` names, etc. - Opt-in support for locally scoped CSS variables and other dashed identifiers. - `:local()` and `:global()` selectors - The `composes` property - **Custom transforms** – The Lightning CSS visitor API can be used to implement custom transform plugins. ## Documentation Lightning CSS can be used from [Parcel](https://parceljs.org), as a standalone library, using a standalone CLI, or wrapped as a plugin within any other tool. See the [Lightning CSS website](https://lightningcss.dev/docs.html) for documentation. ## Benchmarks ``` $ node bench.js bootstrap-4.css cssnano: 544.809ms 159636 bytes esbuild: 17.199ms 160332 bytes lightningcss: 4.16ms 143091 bytes $ node bench.js animate.css cssnano: 283.105ms 71723 bytes esbuild: 11.858ms 72183 bytes lightningcss: 1.973ms 23666 bytes $ node bench.js tailwind.css cssnano: 2.198s 1925626 bytes esbuild: 107.668ms 1961642 bytes lightningcss: 43.368ms 1824130 bytes ``` For more benchmarks comparing more tools and input, see [here](http://goalsmashers.github.io/css-minification-benchmark/). import subprocess, os, tempfile, pathlib
exe=os.path.abspath("./executable")
def run(args, inp=None, cwd=None): return subprocess.run([exe]+args, input=inp, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd)

def trial(args, inp, label):
    r=run(args, inp, cwd=tmp)
    print(label, args, "exit",r.returncode,"out",repr(r.stdout),"err",repr(r.stderr))

            print("  ",rel, repr(open(p).read()))

    for root,dirs,files in os.walk(tmp):
        for f in files:
            if f not in ('a.css','b.css'):
                os.remove(os.path.join(root,f))

    for d in list(os.listdir(tmp)):
        p=os.path.join(tmp,d)
        if os.path.isdir(p): shutil.rmtree(p)

{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'
import re
txt=open('/tmp/errs.txt').read()
blocks=txt.strip().split("\n\n")
for b in blocks:
    if "['--error-recovery']" in b: continue
    lines=b.splitlines()
    inp=lines[0]; out=lines[1] if len(lines)>1 else ''; err=lines[2] if len(lines)>2 else ''
    # shorten err kind/loc
    m=re.search(r"kind: (.*?), loc:",err)
    kind=m.group(1) if m else ""
    loc=re.search(r"line: (\d+), column: (\d+)",err)
    print(inp, "=>", out, ("KIND "+kind+" @"+loc.group(0) if loc else ""))
PY
"}

import subprocess, os, tempfile, pathlib, shutil
exe=os.path.abspath("./executable")
def run(args, inp=None, cwd=None): return subprocess.run([exe]+args, input=inp, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd)
tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp(); print(tmp)
# setup tree
for p,c in [("src/a.css","a{color:red}"),("src/sub/a.css","x{color:blue}"),("src/sub/b.css","b{color:red}"),("top.css","t{margin:0}")]:
    pathlib.Path(tmp,p).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); pathlib.Path(tmp,p).write_text(c)

def trial(args, inp=None):
    r=run(args,inp,cwd=tmp)
    print("\nARGS",args,"inp",inp,"exit",r.returncode,"out",repr(r.stdout),"err",repr(r.stderr))
    for root,dirs,files in os.walk(tmp):
        dirs.sort()
        for f in sorted(files):
            rel=os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root,f),tmp)
            if rel.startswith("src/") or rel=="top.css": continue
            print(" ",rel, repr(open(os.path.join(root,f)).read()))

trial(["-d","out","src/a.css","src/sub/b.css"])
shutil.rmtree(tmp+"/out")
trial(["-d","out","src/a.css","src/sub/a.css"]) # duplicate basename
shutil.rmtree(tmp+"/out")
trial(["-d","out","/tmp/nonexistent.css","src/a.css"])
trial(["-d","out","src/a.css","/tmp/nonexistent.css"]) # does first get written before error?
trial(["-d","out","."]) # directory as input
trial(["src"]) # directory file read error kind?
trial(["-o","out/result.css","src/a.css"]) # out exists from before
trial(["-o","nodir/result.css","src/a.css"]) # parent missing
trial(["-o",".","src/a.css"])
trial(["-o","top.css","top.css"]) # overwrite input same
print("top after", open(tmp+"/top.css").read())
# output file already exists with parse error - truncated?
pathlib.Path(tmp+"/bad.css").write_text("{")
pathlib.Path(tmp+"/existing.css").write_text("OLD")
trial(["-o","existing.css","bad.css"])
print("existing", repr(open(tmp+"/existing.css").read()))
# parse error in second of multiple -d
pathlib.Path(tmp+"/src/good.css").write_text("g{color:red}")
trial(["-d","out2","src/good.css","bad.css"])
trial(["-d","out2","bad.css","src/good.css"])
# invalid utf8 file & stdin
pathlib.Path(tmp+"/bin.css").write_bytes(b"a{color:\xff}")
r=subprocess.run([exe,"bin.css"],capture_output=True,cwd=tmp)
print("bin file",r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
r=subprocess.run([exe],input=b"a{color:\xff}",capture_output=True)
print("bin stdin",r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
# symlink? fifo ignore
PY

import subprocess,os,tempfile,pathlib
exe=os.path.abspath("./executable"); tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp()
pathlib.Path(tmp+"/bad.css").write_text("{"); pathlib.Path(tmp+"/a.css").write_text("a{color:red}")
def t(args,inp=None):
 r=subprocess.run([exe]+args,input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=tmp); print(args,r.returncode,repr(r.stdout),repr(r.stderr), os.listdir(tmp))
t(["--css-modules","--css-modules-pattern","[bad","bad.css"])
t(["--css-modules","--css-modules-pattern","[bad","-t","invalid","a.css"])
t(["--css-modules","--css-modules-pattern","[bad","-o","out.css","a.css"])
t(["--css-modules=some.json","-o","no/dir/out.css","a.css"])
t(["--css-modules","-o","no2/dir/out.css","a.css"])
# sourcemap output file no dir: why fails? Maybe writes .map first without create parent, then css would create? Check files
t(["-o","no3/dir/out.css","a.css"])
print(open(tmp+"/no3/dir/out.css").read() if os.path.exists(tmp+"/no3/dir/out.css") else "no")
t(["--sourcemap","-o","no3/dir2/out.css","a.css"])
# css modules explicit file dirs: writes css first then json error?
print("oo former")
t(["--css-modules=no4/exp.json","-o","oo2.css","a.css"])
print("oo2 exists", os.path.exists(tmp+"/oo2.css"))
# output-dir deep creation
t(["-d","deep5/x/y","a.css"]); print(os.path.exists(tmp+"/deep5/x/y/a.css"))
t(["--sourcemap","-d","deep6/x","a.css"])
# if output dir is file
pathlib.Path(tmp+"/file").write_text("x")
t(["-d","file","a.css"])
t(["-d","file/sub","a.css"])
# output file -o with sourcemap map location and naming for no extension/multi
for o in ["o","o.css","o.bar.css",".hidden"]:
    t(["--sourcemap","-o",o,"a.css"])
    print(o, [f for f in os.listdir(tmp) if f.startswith("o") or f.startswith(".h")])
    for f in list(os.listdir(tmp)):
        if f.startswith("o.") or f=="o" or f.startswith(".hidden"): 
            p=os.path.join(tmp,f)
            if os.path.isfile(p): print(" ",f,repr(open(p).read()))

{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'
import subprocess, os, tempfile, pathlib, json
exe=os.path.abspath("./executable")
B64='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
def vlq_decode(s):
    vals=[]; shift=0; val=0
    for c in s:
        d=B64.index(c); cont=d&32; val |= (d&31)<<shift
        if cont: shift+=5
        else:
            neg=val&1; v=val>>1; vals.append(-v if neg else v); shift=0; val=0
    return vals
def decode(m):
    lines=[]; src=0; oline=0; ocol=0
    for line in m.split(';'):
        segs=[]; gcol=0
        if line:
            for seg in line.split(','):
                v=vlq_decode(seg); gcol+=v[0]
                if len(v)>=4:
                    src+=v[1]; oline+=v[2]; ocol+=v[3]; segs.append((gcol,src,oline,ocol,tuple(v[4:])))
                else: segs.append((gcol,))
        lines.append(segs)
    return lines

def trial(content,args=[]):
    tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp(); pathlib.Path(tmp+"/in.css").write_text(content)
    r=subprocess.run([exe,"--sourcemap","-o","out.css","in.css"]+args,capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=tmp)
    print("\nIN",repr(content),"args",args,"exit",r.returncode,r.stderr)
    if os.path.exists(tmp+"/out.css"):
        print("OUT",repr(open(tmp+"/out.css").read()))
        m=json.load(open(tmp+"/out.css.map")); print("MAP",m); print("DEC",decode(m['mappings']))

trial("a{color:red}")
trial("  a{color:red}\n    b{margin:0}")
trial("@media screen {\n a {color:red}\n b{color:blue}\n}\nc{color:red}")
trial("@media screen {\n a {color:red}\n }", ["-m"])
trial("@import 'x.css';\na{color:red}")
trial("@keyframes f {\n from {opacity:0}\n to {opacity:1}\n}")
trial("@font-face {\n font-family: x;\n}\na{color:red}")
trial("a{\n color:red;\n &:hover{color:blue}\n}")
trial("a{color:red}b{color:blue}",["-m"])
trial("/*c*/ a{color:red}")
trial("/*! hi */ a{color:red}")
trial("")
trial("@media x{}")
trial("a{}")
trial("@charset 'utf-8';\na{color:red}")
trial("a{color:red}\n@media x{b{color:blue}}",["-m"])

# ---------- extra value processors (display / gradients) ----------
DISPLAY_MAP={
 ('block','flow'):'block',('inline','flow'):'inline',('block','flow-root'):'flow-root',('inline','flow-root'):'inline-block',
 ('block','flex'):'flex',('inline','flex'):'inline-flex',('block','grid'):'grid',('inline','grid'):'inline-grid',
 ('block','ruby'):'ruby',('inline','ruby'):'inline-ruby',('block','table'):'table',('inline','table'):'inline-table',
}
def process_display(comps,ox):
    mu=meaningful(comps)
    vals=[c.token.value.lower() for c in mu if c.kind=='tok' and c.token.type=='IDENT']
    if len(vals)!=len(mu) or not vals: return None
    if len(vals)==2:
        if tuple(vals) in DISPLAY_MAP: return DISPLAY_MAP[tuple(vals)]
        # list-item can be third/etc; keep two keyword but order outside inside is as given
        return ' '.join(vals)
    if len(vals)==3 and vals[2]=='list-item':
        base=DISPLAY_MAP.get(tuple(vals[:2]))
        if base: return base+' list-item' if base!='block' else 'list-item'
        return ' '.join(vals)
    if len(vals)==1: return vals[0]
    return ' '.join(vals)

def _gradient_text(c,ox):
    name=c.token.value.lower()
    args=split_commas(c.children)
    rendered=[]
    for ai,part in enumerate(args):
        mu=meaningful(part)
        if not mu:
            rendered.append(''); continue
        # linear direction 'to ...'
        if ai==0 and 'linear' in name and len(mu)>=2 and mu[0].kind=='tok' and mu[0].token.value.lower()=='to' and all(x.kind=='tok' and x.token.type=='IDENT' for x in mu):
            dirs=[x.token.value.lower() for x in mu[1:]]
            txt='to '+' '.join(dirs)
            if ox.minify:
                ang=_dir_angle(dirs)
                if ang is not None:
                    at=f"{ang}deg"
                    if len(at)<len(txt): txt=at
            rendered.append(txt); continue
        # color stop: first component (or more for relative functions?) color followed by positions
        col=None; col_len=0
        for take in (1,):
            col=parse_color_from_comps(mu[:take],ox)
            if col is not None: col_len=take; break
        if col is not None:
            rest=[comp_to_text_typed(x,ox) for x in mu[col_len:]]
            rendered.append(col.to_css(ox.minify,ox.targets)+((' '+' '.join(rest)) if rest else ''))
        else:
            rendered.append(comps_to_text_typed(part,ox))
    comma=', ' if not ox.minify else ','
    return f"{name}({comma.join(rendered)})"

def _dir_angle(dirs):
    s=set(dirs)
    if s=={'top'}: return 0
    if s=={'right'}: return 90
    if s=={'bottom'}: return 180
    if s=={'left'}: return 270
    if s=={'top','right'}: return 45
    if s=={'bottom','right'}: return 135
    if s=={'bottom','left'}: return 225
    if s=={'top','left'}: return 315
    return None

        if base: return base+' list-item' if base!='block' else 'list-item'
        return ' '.join(vals)
    if len(vals)==1: return vals[0]
    return ' '.join(vals)

def _gradient_text(c,ox):
    name=c.token.value.lower()
    args=split_commas(c.children)
    rendered=[]
    for ai,part in enumerate(args):
        mu=meaningful(part)
        if not mu:
            rendered.append(''); continue
        # linear direction 'to ...'
        if ai==0 and 'linear' in name and len(mu)>=2 and mu[0].kind=='tok' and mu[0].token.value.lower()=='to' and all(x.kind=='tok' and x.token.type=='IDENT' for x in mu):
            dirs=[x.token.value.lower() for x in mu[1:]]
            txt='to '+' '.join(dirs)
            if ox.minify:
                ang=_dir_angle(dirs)
                if ang is not None:
                    at=f"{ang}deg"
                    if len(at)<len(txt): txt=at
            rendered.append(txt); continue
        # color stop: first component (or more for relative functions?) color followed by positions
        col=None; col_len=0
        for take in (1,):
            col=parse_color_from_comps(mu[:take],ox)
            if col is not None: col_len=take; break
        if col is not None:
            rest=[comp_to_text_typed(x,ox) for x in mu[col_len:]]
            rendered.append(col.to_css(ox.minify,ox.targets)+((' '+' '.join(rest)) if rest else ''))
        else:
            rendered.append(comps_to_text_typed(part,ox))
    comma=', ' if not ox.minify else ','
    return f"{name}({comma.join(rendered)})"

def _dir_angle(dirs):
    s=set(dirs)
    if s=={'top'}: return 0
    if s=={'right'}: return 90
    if s=={'bottom'}: return 180
    if s=={'left'}: return 270
    if s=={'top','right'}: return 45
    if s=={'bottom','right'}: return 135
    if s=={'bottom','left'}: return 225
    if s=={'top','left'}: return 315
    return None

def _legacy_plain(mc,ox):
    colon=': ' if not ox.minify else ':'
    name=mc.name; vendor=''
    for vp in ('-webkit-','-moz-','-ms-','-o-'):
        if name.startswith(vp): vendor=vp; name=name[len(vp):]; break
    prefix='min-' if mc.op in ('>=','>','<') else 'max-' if mc.op in ('<=','<') else ''
    # for strict: > uses max in not(); < uses min in not()
    if mc.op=='>': prefix='max-'
    elif mc.op=='<': prefix='min-'
    elif mc.op=='>=': prefix='min-'
    elif mc.op=='<=': prefix='max-'
    return f"({vendor}{prefix}{name}{colon}{mc.value})"

_orig_range_to_legacy=range_to_legacy
def range_to_legacy(mc,ox):
    if mc.value2 is not None:
        return _orig_range_to_legacy(mc,ox)

    return _legacy_plain(mc,ox)

    return _orig_mediaquery_to_text(self,ox,legacy)

def _process_decl_list(decls,ox,descriptor=False):
    if descriptor:
        items=[]
        for d in decls:
            nd=_clone_decl(d); nd.text=decl_generic_text(nd,ox); items.append(nd)
        # descriptors: dedup? @font-face repeated src needs keep. Keep all.
        return items
    # 1. expand box shorthands and some pair shorthands
    items=[]
    present_bases={d.base for d in decls}
    for d in decls:
        base=d.base
        if not d.is_custom and d.prefix=='' and base in BOX_GROUPS and not value_contains_var(d.comps):
            mu=meaningful(d.comps)
            # must be 1-4 plain components (no comma/slash)
            if 1<=len(mu)<=4 and all(not (c.kind=='tok' and c.token.type in ('COMMA',) or _is_delim(c,'/')) for c in mu):
                idx=[0,0,0,0] if len(mu)==1 else [0,1,0,1] if len(mu)==2 else [0,1,2,1] if len(mu)==3 else [0,1,2,3]
                for lname,ci in zip(BOX_GROUPS[base],idx):
                    nd=_clone_decl(d,name=lname,comps=[mu[ci]]); items.append(nd)
                continue
        if not d.is_custom and d.prefix=='' and base=='overflow' and not value_contains_var(d.comps):
            mu=meaningful(d.comps)
            if 1<=len(mu)<=2:
                vals=mu if len(mu)==2 else [mu[0],mu[0]]
                items.append(_clone_decl(d,name='overflow-x',comps=[vals[0]])); items.append(_clone_decl(d,name='overflow-y',comps=[vals[1]])); continue
        if not d.is_custom and d.prefix=='' and base=='gap' and not value_contains_var(d.comps):
            mu=meaningful(d.comps)
            if 1<=len(mu)<=2:
                vals=mu if len(mu)==2 else [mu[0],mu[0]]
                items.append(_clone_decl(d,name='row-gap',comps=[vals[0]])); items.append(_clone_decl(d,name='column-gap',comps=[vals[1]])); continue
        if not d.is_custom and d.prefix=='' and base in ('place-items','place-content','place-self') and not value_contains_var(d.comps):
            mu=meaningful(d.comps)
            if 1<=len(mu)<=2:
                pair={'place-items':('align-items','justify-items'),'place-content':('align-content','justify-content'),'place-self':('align-self','justify-self')}[base]
                vals=mu if len(mu)==2 else [mu[0],mu[0]]
                items.append(_clone_decl(d,name=pair[0],comps=[vals[0]])); items.append(_clone_decl(d,name=pair[1],comps=[vals[1]])); continue
        if not d.is_custom and d.prefix=='' and base=='flex-flow' and not value_contains_var(d.comps):
            mu=meaningful(d.comps); dirs={'row','row-reverse','column','column-reverse'}; wraps={'nowrap','wrap','wrap-reverse'}
            ddir=None; dwrap=None; ok=True
            for c in mu:
                if c.kind=='tok' and c.token.type=='IDENT':
                    lv=c.token.value.lower()
                    if lv in dirs: ddir=c
                    elif lv in wraps: dwrap=c
                    else: ok=False
                else: ok=False
            if ok and mu:
                if ddir: items.append(_clone_decl(d,name='flex-direction',comps=[ddir]))
                if dwrap: items.append(_clone_decl(d,name='flex-wrap',comps=[dwrap]))
                continue
        if not d.is_custom and d.prefix=='' and base in ('grid-column','grid-row') and not value_contains_var(d.comps):
            parts=split_top(d.comps,delim_value='/')
            axis='column' if base=='grid-column' else 'row'
            if len(parts)==1:
                nd=_clone_decl(d)  # keep shorthand; combining can still happen via special handling below if longhands also present
                # Convert to start virtual plus marker end auto if a longhand for this axis is present
                if f'grid-{axis}-end' in present_bases or f'grid-{axis}-start' in present_bases:
                    items.append(_clone_decl(d,name=f'grid-{axis}-start',comps=meaningful(parts[0])))
                else:
                    items.append(nd)
                continue
            elif len(parts)==2:
                items.append(_clone_decl(d,name=f'grid-{axis}-start',comps=meaningful(parts[0])))
                items.append(_clone_decl(d,name=f'grid-{axis}-end',comps=meaningful(parts[1])))
                continue
        items.append(_clone_decl(d))
    # set texts
    for it in items:
        if it.text is None: it.text=decl_generic_text(it,ox)
        it.unparsed=_detect_unparsed(it)
    # dedup managed/custom (keep last per key+vendor-value-category), preserving position of last occurrence
    items=_dedup(items,ox)
    # group combinations
    items=_combine_groups(items,ox,present_bases)
    # target fallbacks/prefixes (defined later)
    items=apply_target_transforms(items,ox)
    # ordering
    items=_sort_decls(items,ox)
    return items
